profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: Accomplished software engineer with 3 years of experience in mobile application development and deployment, specializing in React Native. Proven track record of enhancing user experience through UI/UX improvements and effective collaboration with cross-functional teams. Successfully managed external development teams to deliver a mobile application from concept to successful release.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Spearheaded the re-development of the company mobile application in React Native, overseeing the project from concept to general availability (GA) release, and managed all deployment activities.

Sole stakeholder for both the company’s original and rebuilt mobile applications. Provided maintenance,  support and testing.

Redesigned the user flow, optimized the loading screen and refactored application code that reduced load time by 27% and resulted in a 30% reduction in support calls.

positions.title: Video Production Specialist
positions.locationName: St Louis, Missouri, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Operated VTR equipment to record and playback video and sound during productions.

Assisted senior production staff, including producers, directors, and production coordinators.

Coordinated script writing, distribution, and research for STL TV Live.

Prepared sets by organizing lights, equipment, cameras and props.

Handled other technical duties including graphics and editing (Avid, Final Cut).

Answered phones and other administrative tasks.
positions.insights: Television Studio Production, Scriptwriting and +3 skills

positions.title: Team Lead, Web Development and Computer Science
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Mentored students across web development and computer science curriculum, providing guidance and support throughout their learning journey.

Coached students using strategic problem-solving techniques to help them overcome assignment challenges.

Achieved a 97% student pass rate through consistent mentorship and tailored guidance.
